meaning: Making up a fake person online, with a fake name and photos, to fool someone into a friendship or love.
clues: Someone is pretending to be a person who does not exist, or is not who they say.
It happens through chats and online profiles.
The person uses fake photos and a made-up name.
The aim might be love, friendship, or tricking someone into giving them something.
It has ten letters and starts with C. Its name sounds like a pet plus a hobby.
assumes: Spoofing is faking a phone number
Doxxing is posting someone's private details online

decoys.meaning: Putting a person's home address or other private facts online without asking them.
Making a call or text look like it came from a different phone number than the real one.
Someone steals your real details, like your name or account numbers, and uses them as their own, such as to buy things.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, a pen pal mailed a real photo. Now anyone can borrow one.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try a video call. If they always have an excuse not to be on camera, be careful.

sources.name: FTC, What To Know About Romance Scams

blank.sentence: My friend's new online pal used a fake name and fake photos to win her trust. That is ___.

why: A made-up person with fake photos can fool someone into a friendship or love.
short: Pretending to be someone else online
